title: UniRank: Benchmarking Ranking Models for Unified Sequential Modeling and Feature Interaction
abstract: arXiv:2607.19987v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Ranking is a core stage in online advertising and recommender systems. Modern ranking models increasingly unify sequential modeling and feature interaction, yet many advances rely on proprietary data, closed implementations, and large-scale industrial infrastructure. This setting limits reproducible comparison and hinders academic study of scaling laws, long-sequence modeling, and multi-task ranking. To address these limitations, this paper proposes UniRank, an open benchmark for ranking models that unify sequential modeling and feature interaction. UniRank uses chronological pointwise autoregressive supervision, standardizes evaluation across feedback tasks, and provides a PyTorch toolkit with Distributed Data Parallel training, operator optimization, mixed-precision training, attention optimization, and other efficiency techniques that reduce hardware requirements. translated_title: UniRank：面向统一序列建模与特征交互的排序模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 排序是在线广告和推荐系统中的核心环节。现代排序模型日益将序列建模与特征交互相统一，然而许多研究进展依赖于专有数据、闭源实现和大规模工业基础设施。这种现状限制了可复现的模型比较，也阻碍了学术界对扩展规律、长序列建模和多任务排序的研究。为解决这些局限性，本文提出了UniRank，一个统一序列建模与特征交互的排序模型开放基准。UniRank采用按时间顺序的逐点自回归监督方式，标准化了跨反馈任务的评估流程，并提供了一个PyTorch工具包，包含分布式数据并行训练、算子优化、混合精度训练、注意力优化等效率提升技术，从而降低了硬件需求。我们在五个公开数据集上对15个具有代表性的统一排序模型进行了基准测试。
tldr: UniRank提出了一个统一序列建模与特征交互的开放排序模型基准，通过标准化的评估流程和降低硬件门槛的高效PyTorch工具包，首次实现了15个代表性统一排序模型在公开数据集上的可复现比较。
en_tdlr: UniRank introduces an open benchmark for ranking models unifying sequential modeling and feature interaction, enabling reproducible comparison of 15 representative models on public datasets through standardized evaluation and an efficient PyTorch toolkit that lowers hardware requirements.
